AnalysisWarning.description:
Something about the input or the critical surface that the factor of
safety alone does not show, in English for display.

count.description: Slices of the critical surface concerned (the slice warnings).

AnalysisWarningCode.description: Kind of a result warning (see analysisWarnings).

Crack.description: The tension crack a surface was cut off at (`SlipSurfaceResult.crack`).

CustomPlaneKind.description: Which list of the definition a custom search plane is in.

CustomPlaneRef.description: A custom search plane of the definition: its list and its index there.

CustomSurfaceResult.description:
The result of one custom search plane of the definition: its surface
with its factor of safety (also in `allSurfaces`), or why it has none.

reason.description: Why the plane has no factor of safety, when it has none.

surface.description: The analysed surface, when it has a factor of safety.

DepthReference.description:
Where the depth of an `s-f-depth` material is measured from. Another
string is kept as it is, for validation to report.

DrawdownEnvelope.description:
The drawdown (R) envelope of a soil that does not drain during rapid
drawdown: the total-stress envelope of isotropically consolidated
undrained tests (cR, φR), for the three-stage drawdown analysis.

FemBounds.description: Lower and upper bounds of limit analysis (`FemResultSummary.bounds`).

davis.description:
The same bounds with Davis B's reduced strength for the dilation
angle (limit-common.ts): the associated material that stands for
non-associated flow, below the bounds above. Absent in older results.

refinements.description: Refinements on the bound gap (bound-adapt.ts); absent in older results: none.

FemCurvePoint.description: One point of the F–displacement curve (`FemResultSummary.curve`).

FemDavisBounds.description: Bounds with Davis B's reduced strength (`FemBounds.davis`).

FemLevel.description: Elements and F of one mesh (`FemResultSummary.levels`).

FemResultSummary.description: Result of the finite element analysis in model coordinates, as plain arrays (JSON).

bounds.description: Lower and upper bounds of limit analysis (null where not found), when asked for.

curve.description:
The converged trials of the final mesh that rose from a converged
state, by increasing F: the largest displacement component (m) at each
reduction factor (the F–displacement curve; it turns flat at
failure). Absent in results saved before it.

displacement.description: Displacement (x, y) per node at the factor of safety (m).

factorOfSafety.description: Factor of safety by strength reduction (largest converged F).

failedF.description: Smallest F that did not converge.

levels.description: Elements and F per mesh, coarsest first.

piles.description: The piles' largest forces at the factor of safety, per pile (kN, kNm), in the slope's pile order.

plasticShear.description: Plastic shear strain per element at the factor of safety.

shearIncrement.description: Shear strain of the last displacement increment per element: the failure mechanism.

triangles.description: Corner nodes of each element (3 per element).

x.description: Corner node coordinates of the final mesh.

FlowRule.description: Flow rule of the finite element analysis.

Material.description:
A material. Serialized as the worker posts a `Material` instance
(structured clone of its fields): `{ name, color, model }`. Immutable
once created: a slope's table entry is replaced, never edited, so `Arc`
clones of the model stay valid snapshots (ARCHITECTURE.md §1).

model.description: The material: unit weight and strength (see `resolve_strength`).

MaterialModel.description: A material model: unit weight and strength. `kind` names the model.

aboveWater.description:
The strength of the material above its water line (the phreatic
level), when it differs from the strength below it (for example drained
above and undrained below). It also applies everywhere when the
material has no water line. Its unit weight is this model's.

bBar.description:
B̄ (B-bar): the excess pore pressure at a slice base in this material
is B̄ times the vertical stress of the fill above it (the materials
with `b_bar_load`), added to the pore pressure of its water line: the
short-term pore pressure of a soft foundation under a new fill
(Skempton 1954; Bishop 1954). Not set: none.

bBarLoad.description:
The weight of this material (a fill) raises the pore pressure of materials with `b_bar` below it.
(`if (model.bBarLoad)`: any value by its truthiness.)

cFactor.description:
Combined-method c-factor: the drained c′ is `cohesion` × cFactor.
0 = not combined, so cFactor = 0 cannot give a combined material
with c′ = 0; that takes `cohesion` = 0, any other cFactor and
`cohesionUndrained` set.

cohesionRateOfChange.description: Rate of cohesion increase per metre below the reference elevation (kPa/m).

cohesionRefDepth.description:
Reference ELEVATION y (m, despite the name) where c = `cohesion`:
c = cohesion + (cohesionRefDepth − y_base) × cohesionRateOfChange.

cohesionUndrained.description: Undrained cohesion Su (kPa). Used by Combined method.

drawdownStrength.description:
The drawdown (R) envelope: with a rapid drawdown analysis
(SlopeDefinition.rapidDrawdown) the soil does not drain and takes the
undrained strength of the three-stage procedure (model/drawdown.ts).
Not set: free-draining, its drained strength throughout.

maxSuction.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.maxSuction`: largest matric suction (kPa) taken
into account, > 0. Not set: no limit.

phiB.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.phiB`: angle φb (°) of the strength increase with
matric suction, 0 ≤ φb < 90. Not set or 0: no suction strength.

ru.description:
Pore pressure ratio rᵤ = u / σv (Bishop & Morgenstern 1960): the pore
pressure at a slice base in this material is rᵤ times the weight of
the soil above it per unit width, added to the pore pressure of its
water line (if any). Not set: none.

line. Not set: `unit_weight` throughout.

anisotropy.description:
`UndrainedAnisotropy.anisotropy`: Su is multiplied by a factor that
depends on the slice base inclination α, given as [[α°, factor], …]
and interpolated linearly (constant beyond the ends), as

down in the direction of sliding (the active zone near the crest),
negative where it rises (the passive zone at the toe). For example
[[-45, 0.82], [0, 1], [60, 1.5]] for passive 0.82, direct 1.0 and active
1.5 relative to the direct shear strength. Analyses without a slip
surface base (finite elements, limit analysis, the strength profiles)
take the factor at α = 0. Not set or empty: isotropic.

The user supplies a set of data points with known c, φ, γ values.
At analysis time, the effective parameters are interpolated from
the nearest data points.

oneOf.title: SpatialMohrCoulombModel

oneOf.description:
Anisotropic function model.

Base c and φ are multiplied by a modifier that is a function of the
slice base inclination angle α. The modifier function is supplied
as an array of (α_deg, factor) pairs and linearly interpolated.
The factor scales φ in degrees, not tan φ: 0.8 on φ = 30° gives
24.0°, where 0.8·tan 30° would give 24.8°.

material has no water line. Its unit weight is this model's.

modifierFunction.description:
Modifier vs base inclination: [[α_deg, factor], …].

α is measured relative to the sliding direction, not geometrically:
positive where the slice base dips down in the direction of sliding
(the back scarp), negative where it rises (the toe). The same
function therefore applies unchanged to left- and right-facing slopes.

oneOf.title: AnisotropicFunctionModel

oneOf.description:
Strength as a function of depth.

φ = 0; Su = suRef + (depth − depthRef) × rate,
where depth = yTop − yBottom at the slice base centre, yTop being the
ground surface or the top of the material layer (see `depthReference`).

Combined (with `drainedCohesion` and `drainedFrictionAngle`): the
strength is the lesser of the undrained Su and the drained
c′ + σ′·tan φ′, with c′ = drainedCohesion + (depth − depthRef) ×
drainedCohesionRate at the same depth, as Swedish practice analyses
clay ("kombinerad analys") and commercial programs offer it.

depthRef.description: Reference depth (m) below the depth reference.

depthReference.description:
What the depth is measured from:
- "ground": the ground surface above the slice base;
- "layer-top": the top of the region of this material directly above
  the slice base (as commercial programs offer it); for the uppermost layer this is the ground.

Not set: "ground" (models saved before the option existed).

drainedCohesion.description:
Drained effective cohesion c′ (kPa) at the reference depth, for a
combined analysis. Set together with `drainedFrictionAngle`; either
not set: undrained only.

drainedCohesionRate.description: Change of c′ per metre of depth (kPa/m), with the same depth as Su. Not set: 0.

drainedFrictionAngle.description: Drained friction angle φ′ (°) for a combined analysis (see `drainedCohesion`).

oneOf.title: StrengthFromDatumModel

oneOf.description:
Clay improved with lime-cement columns (KC-pelare): the shear strength of
the improved block is the area-weighted mean of the columns and the soil
between them, τ = a·τcol + (1 − a)·cu,soil. Undrained by default; with a
drained column strength (c′, φ′) the column part is limited to
c′ + σ′·tan φ′ ≤ cu,col (combined analysis), as in Swedish practice.

use its instantaneous Mohr–Coulomb parameters at the normal stress on the
slip surface (types/hoek_brown.rs).

oneOf.title: HoekBrownModel

oneOf.description:
SHANSEP (Ladd & Foott 1974): the undrained strength from the effective
vertical stress at the slice base and the stress history,
Su = σ′v · S · OCR^m, with OCR constant or a function of elevation; or
Su as a function of σ′v. σ′v is the slice's weight and surface loads per
unit width less the pore pressure at its base (the overburden on the
base in the analysis's pore pressures), as commercial programs take it.

bBarLoad.description:
The weight of this material (a fill) raises the pore pressure of materials with `b_bar` below it.
(`if (model.bBarLoad)`: any value by its truthiness.)

maxSuction.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.maxSuction`: largest matric suction (kPa) taken
into account, > 0. Not set: no limit.

ocrByElevation.description: OCR against elevation, [[y, OCR], …], interpolated linearly (constant beyond the ends); replaces `ocr`.

phiB.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.phiB`: angle φb (°) of the strength increase with
matric suction, 0 ≤ φb < 90. Not set or 0: no suction strength.

pop.description:
Pre-overburden pressure POP (kPa): OCR = (σ′v + POP)/σ′v at the base.
Replaces `ocr` and `ocrByElevation`.

ratio.description: S, the Su/σ′v ratio of the normally consolidated soil.

ru.description:
Pore pressure ratio rᵤ = u / σv (Bishop & Morgenstern 1960): the pore
pressure at a slice base in this material is rᵤ times the weight of
the soil above it per unit width, added to the pore pressure of its
water line (if any). Not set: none.

spline.description: Cubic splines through `ocrByElevation` / `suByStress` instead of straight lines; constant beyond the ends as with straight lines.

suByStress.description: Su against σ′v, [[σ′v, Su], …], interpolated linearly (constant beyond the ends); replaces S, m and OCR.

unitWeightSat.description:
Saturated unit weight (kN/m³) for the soil below the material's water
line. Not set: `unit_weight` throughout.

yieldFromEarlierStage.description:
With an earlier stage (SlopeDefinition.earlierStage): the yield stress
is the effective vertical stress of the earlier stage at the base, with
its distributed loads over the base taken straight down (no spreading
with depth), plus `pop` (the stress history the soil kept from it),
OCR = σ′y/σ′v, at least 1.
(`yieldFromEarlierStage === true`: any other value is false.)

yieldStress.description: Yield (preconsolidation) stress σ′y (kPa): OCR = σ′y/σ′v at the base, at least 1. Replaces `ocr` and `ocrByElevation`.

oneOf.title: ShansepModel

oneOf.description:
A curved strength envelope given as points of the shear strength against
the effective normal stress, τ = f(σ′n), interpolated linearly between
them or with a spline (the end segment extended beyond the ends): each
slice base takes the tangent c and φ of the segment at its normal
stress, which the analysis updates from the stress it finds, as for
Hoek-Brown.

aboveWater.description:
The strength of the material above its water line (the phreatic
level), when it differs from the strength below it (for example drained
above and undrained below). It also applies everywhere when the
material has no water line. Its unit weight is this model's.

bBar.description:
B̄ (B-bar): the excess pore pressure at a slice base in this material
is B̄ times the vertical stress of the fill above it (the materials
with `b_bar_load`), added to the pore pressure of its water line: the
short-term pore pressure of a soft foundation under a new fill
(Skempton 1954; Bishop 1954). Not set: none.

bBarLoad.description:
The weight of this material (a fill) raises the pore pressure of materials with `b_bar` below it.
(`if (model.bBarLoad)`: any value by its truthiness.)

maxSuction.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.maxSuction`: largest matric suction (kPa) taken
into account, > 0. Not set: no limit.

phiB.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.phiB`: angle φb (°) of the strength increase with
matric suction, 0 ≤ φb < 90. Not set or 0: no suction strength.

ru.description:
Pore pressure ratio rᵤ = u / σv (Bishop & Morgenstern 1960): the pore
pressure at a slice base in this material is rᵤ times the weight of
the soil above it per unit width, added to the pore pressure of its
water line (if any). Not set: none.

spline.description: A cubic spline through the points instead of straight lines (see `TableSpline`).

unitWeightSat.description:
Saturated unit weight (kN/m³) for the soil below the material's water
line. Not set: `unit_weight` throughout.

oneOf.title: ShearNormalModel

PartialFactors.description: Partial factors applied to characteristic values.

basis.description:
How the factors were formed in Swedish practice, for display and
editing (`swedish_partial_factors`); the analyses use the factors above
only. Not set: the factors were entered or taken from another set.

variableLoad.description: γQ on variable loads (distributed and line loads).

ReinforcementForce.description: Applied reinforcement force, per metre of slope.

force.description: Magnitude (kN/m); divided by F in the solvers when passive.

fx.description: Force on the sliding mass (kN/m), +x in the sliding direction, +y up.

index.description: Index of the element in the slope's reinforcement (or pile) list.

x.description: Crossing point with the slip surface.

critical.description: The surface of the smallest F_3D.

f2dCritical.description: F_2D,krit,min: the smallest F_2D of the analysis (non-circular surfaces included).

factorOfSafety.description: The smallest F_3D over the analysed circular surfaces.

Sgi3dResultOptions.description: The options a 3D result was computed with (`Sgi3dResult.options`).

Sgi3dSurface.description: One analysed surface with its 3D factor, its circle in model space.

endFaceArea.description: Area of cohesive soil in the end face counted (m²).

endFaceMoment.description: ∫ c_u r dA over that area (kNm per end face).

baseMaterial.description:
The base material, as the worker posts it: a copy of the material
(name, color, model), not a reference (PORTING.md, Decisions).

normalForce.description: Effective base normal force N′ = N − u·l (kN) from the method's equilibrium at the FOS (solvedEffectiveNormals).

porePressure.description:
Pore water pressure at the base (kPa): negative above the water line
in a material with φb (the matric suction, see Slice.suction), else
≥ 0.

shearForce.description:
Shear force the base can resist, c·l + max(N′, 0)·tan φ (kN): no
friction from a negative effective normal (see the
negative-effective-normal warning). NaN in a result saved before the
field existed.

surfaceLoad.description: UDL and line load acting on the slice (kN).

SlipSurfaceResult.description: A single slip surface with its computed FOS.

closestPair.description:
Morgenstern-Price: the moment and force factors never met and the
closest pair was accepted (gap in `equilibriumGap`). The factor meets
moment equilibrium and force equilibrium only within the gap; the
surface is not converged but keeps its factor.

composite.description: A composite circle: along impenetrable material or the model's base where the circle went below it.

converged.description:
Whether the solver converged for this surface (for Morgenstern-Price:
a crossing Fm = Ff; false for a closest pair, see `closestPair`).

crack.description:
The tension crack the analysis cut the surface off at (critical
surface only): its x, the ground level there (`top`) and the crack
bottom on the surface (`bottom`, = entryPoint's y). Absent without a
crack.

customPlane.description:
The custom search plane of the definition this surface was analysed
for (`customSearchPlanes` or `customSurfaces`, by index). Absent for
a surface of the search.

equilibriumGap.description:
Morgenstern-Price: |Fm − Ff| where the moment and force equilibrium
curves never crossed and the closest pair was accepted (no
complete-equilibrium solution exists on this surface). Absent when
they crossed.

lffArray.description: Lambda-Fm-Ff-gap rows for this surface (Morgenstern-Price only).

points.description:
Non-circular surface: its points from entry to exit (then cx, cy is
the moment axis and radius 0). Absent for a circle. For a composite
circle (`composite`), the surface as analysed, with the circle's
centre and radius.

reinforcementForces.description: Reinforcement forces on the sliding mass (critical surface only).

SpatialInterpolation.description:
Interpolation method of a spatial Mohr-Coulomb model. Another value
(a string or of another type) is kept as it is (TypeScript falls back to
inverse distance weighting).

SwedishFactorBasis.description: The input of a set of Swedish partial factors (`swedish_partial_factors`).

etaCu.description: Conversion factor η on the undrained shear strength: γcu = 1.5 / η.

etaDrained.description: Conversion factor η on c′ and tan φ′: γc′ = γφ′ = 1.3 / η.

safetyClass.description: Safety class 1, 2 or 3: γd = 0.83, 0.91 or 1.0 on the variable loads.

variableLoadBase.description:
γQ before γd: γQ = variableLoadBase · γd. 1.3 gives the EN 1997-1 DA3
load factor in safety class 3; some Swedish guidance uses 1.4 (for
example for traffic loads). The governing document decides.

TableSpline.description:
A cubic spline through a table's points: natural (zero curvature) at an
end without a slope, clamped to the slope given; a straight line with
the end slope beyond the ends (math/spline.rs).

criticalLffArray.description: Lambda-Fm-Ff data for the critical surface (Morgenstern-Price only).

criticalPushingMoment.description: Critical surface pushing moment used in FoS calculations.

criticalResistingMoment.description: Critical surface resisting moment used in FoS calculations.

criticalSlipVolume.description: Critical slip volume (2D area, i.e. volume per unit width).

customSurfaces.description:
The custom search planes of the definition, in its order (circles,
then polylines), each with its surface and factor of safety or the
reason it has none. Absent without custom search planes. Analysed in
the model's own direction (with `bothDirections` too).

discardedBySize.description:
Number of trial surfaces not analysed because they are shallower than
the minimum slip depth or smaller than the minimum slip area.

fem.description: Strength reduction by finite elements, when enabled in the options.

femError.description: Why the finite element analysis failed, when it was enabled and did not complete.

nonConvergedSurfaces.description: Number of analysed surfaces that did not converge within iteration limits.

otherDirectionMinFOS.description: Minimum FOS in the other direction (null: no valid surface).

partialFactors.description:
The partial factors the analysis applied (with their basis): the
strengths were design values and `min_fos` is an over-design factor.
Absent: characteristic values (and in results of earlier versions).

sgi3d.description: 3D effects after SGI's guidance (AnalysisOptions.sgi3d), its circle in model space.

sgi3dError.description: Why the 3D effects could not be computed, when they could not.

slidingDirection.description:
Sliding direction of the reported surfaces in model space: "ltr" =
towards +x. Set when both directions were analysed.

splitFailureCount.description: Number of geometry split operations that failed and fell back to unsplit.

warnings.description: Warnings on the input and the critical surface (none: omitted or empty).
